section.title: `GET·/{package}`
section.p: This endpoint responds with the package metadata document, sometimes informally called a "packument" or "doc.json". The format of the response is described in detail in the [package metadata documentation](responses/package-metadata.md).

section.title: `GET·/-/v1/search`

tr.td: how many results should be returned (default 20, max 250)
how much of an effect should quality have on search results
how much of an effect should popularity have on search results
how much of an effect should maintenance have on search results

section.p: _Note: the values of `quality`, `popularity`, and `maintenance` are normalized into a unit-vector provide values between `0 - 1` for each to modify weightings, e.g., to return results based solely on `quality`, set `quality=1.0`, `maintenance=0.0`, `popularity=0.0`._
Special search qualifiers can be provided in the full-text query:

list.item: `author:bcoe`: Show/filter results in which `bcoe` is the author
`maintainer:bcoe`: Show/filter results in which `bcoe` is qualifier as a maintainer
`scope:foo`: Show/filter results published under the `@foo` scope
`keywords:batman`: Show/filter results that have `batman` in the keywords
`,-` can be used to exclude keywords
`not:insecure`: Exclude packages that are insecure or have vulnerable dependencies (based on the [nsp](https://nodesecurity.io/) registry)
`is:insecure`: Show/filter packages that are insecure or have vulnerable dependencies (based on the [nsp](https://nodesecurity.io/) registry)
`boost-exact:false`: Do not boost exact matches, defaults to `true`
